title: LearnOps course model (B2, v1)
description: DRAFT, not approved and not frozen. All 17 unresolved decisions are recorded in docs/traceability.md. The OPEN DECISION markers in this schema identify only some unresolved fields and are not the complete list, so a field without a marker is not settled. A normalised JSON description of a course, read by the checker and built from a Moodle backup (.mbz) or a course package (PRD B2). It describes what a course IS, including a broken course, so that the checker can report the problem. This schema checks structure only and must never reject a course-design error.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). A null means the source does not carry the value, for example a package has no Moodle visibility setting, or that the item does not exist, as stated on each field. Deliberately NOT enforced here, because a course that breaks them must still validate so that a rule can report it: unique or well-formed idnumbers (CK-06), protected items (CK-07), points summing to the target (CK-03), references inside availability, criteria or badges pointing at real activities (CK-04, CK-08), circular unlock rules (CK-05), completion rules that can be met (CK-02), a valid marking table with matching points (CK-09), marking workflow being on (CK-10), H5P having no grade item (CK-11), relative media paths (CK-12), and completion tracking on activities used in unlock rules (CK-13). The inner form of availability belongs to Moodle and is not described here. Unique cmid values are not enforced either; the model builder guarantees them.

badges.description: null when the source does not carry them: a package never does (PRD B1.4). An empty array means the source carries badges and has none.

idnumber.description: As found in the source, with no format check, because invalid and duplicate values are what CK-06 reports. null when there is none. Protected idnumbers are allowed, because CK-07 needs to see them (unlike B1, which rejects them).

visible.description: null when the source does not carry it, as in a package.

availability.description: Moodle's own availability JSON, kept whole so that no information is lost (PRD B2). null means no restriction. A package unlock rule is written in this same form.

cmid.description: OPEN DECISION: not in the PRD key fields. Moodle's course-module id, which availability conditions, completion criteria and badges use to refer to an activity. For a package the builder assigns synthetic ids. Unique within one model and meaningless across models, so a comparison uses idnumber.

source.description: OPEN DECISION: not in the PRD key fields. Where the model came from.

mode.description: The package's output mode (PRD B1.4). CK-07 needs it, because a sections-only package leaves out the protected items on purpose.

completion_enabled.description: Course-level completion tracking. null when the source does not carry it, as in a package.

total_points.description: OPEN DECISION: not in the PRD key fields. The target total for CK-03 when the source states one. A .mbz does not, so the target then comes from rule configuration.

number.description: Moodle's section number. Moodle has a section 0, so the minimum is 0, not 1 as in B1.

idnumber.description: OPEN DECISION: the PRD lists this, but Moodle sections are not known to have an idnumber, so it is expected to be null for a .mbz until checked against a real backup.

activities.description: In course order. May be empty.

completion.description: The activity's completion rule. A rule that can never be met must still validate (CK-02).

use_grade.description: Complete when a grade is received.

pass_grade.description: Complete only with a passing grade.

grade_item.description: null means no grade item. This also answers whether an H5P activity is graded (PRD B2, CK-11).

max_grade.description: Maximum grade. A number, not an integer, because Moodle grades can be decimal.

marking_table.description: OPEN DECISION: the PRD lists only presence, but CK-09 also compares points.

points_total.description: Sum of the table's Points column. null when there is no table or it cannot be parsed.

type.description: page, assignment, url, label or h5p (the B1 names). Any other type keeps Moodle's module name and is reported as not checked (PRD C2.8), so this is not an enum.

marking_workflow.description: null when the source does not carry it, as in a package.

media_refs.description: OPEN DECISION: not in the PRD key fields. Every media reference found in the activity, as written, so that CK-12 can report full URLs. Empty means none found; absent means not collected.

criterion.description: One course-completion or badge criterion. CK-08 reports a criterion that refers to a missing item, so the reference is not checked here.

type.description: The kind of criterion, for example activity. Open, because Moodle has several.

cmid.description: The activity referred to, as found in the source. It may not exist in this model.

idnumber.description: The referred activity's idnumber, when the builder can resolve it.

course_completion.description: null when the source does not carry it: a package never does (PRD B1.4).
